# VEX test data

- `openvex_json_schema.json`: the OpenVEX 0.2.0 JSON schema, from
  https://github.com/openvex/spec/blob/61b5f885d0f481f48683c93345e49ef1a6e9fdff/openvex_json_schema.json
  (pinned commit; update it deliberately with the spec version ShieldMon writes).
- `openvex-vendor.json`, `cyclonedx-vex.json`: documents in the shape of the specs'
  examples, with one statement per case the importer must accept or skip.
